notes: Actual independent static approval. This report is not a scientific execution result. Valid only for the frozen source plus the unique False-to-True enable line and the root gates and failure disposition stated here. Root may copy these exact bytes into protocols/independent_review.json and pin their SHA.
accepted_nonblocking_limitations: Resource guard finalization may itself fail; complete actual progress cannot be recovered without a valid final receipt.
Hard CPU/wall termination may leave only an initial snapshot or partial files.
RSS is sampled process peak telemetry; no instantaneous hard RSS bound is claimed.
Interpreter pre-entry startup and final completion serialization/shutdown need the external whole-launch receipt.
Static approval does not establish SQLite runtime capability, concrete generated input hashes, returned counts or performance.

required_root_failure_disposition.trigger: Missing or invalid final result/completion receipt, hash mismatch, nonzero exit, signal termination, or incomplete external launch receipt
required_root_failure_disposition.valid_failure_receipt: Preserve its actual completed/failed/notrun progress and exact counters without retry; whole run remains NOTCOMPLETED.
required_root_failure_disposition.external_failure_after_internal_complete: Preserve observed values but do not claim whole-run completion.

remaining_prelaunch_gates_owned_by_root: Copy and hash this exact approval report into the execution freeze.
Change only the enable line and verify enabled source matches the approved expected SHA.
Rehash all three runtime files and launch the fixed Python interpreter.
Require real Darwin load <=4 and memory_pressure -Q free >=25 percent; hash the receipt and keep its age within 60 seconds.
Prepare whole-launch /usr/bin/time -l plus exit-code evidence, include metadata/setup/serialization/shutdown costs, retain one attempt only.
Apply the conservative failure-disposition contract for every incomplete launch.
scientific_scope: One existing synthetic negative theoretical control; no new method, natural case, independent test, novelty or efficiency claim
